text:
Priya: Quick heads-up — final-round interview at 15:00 PT today needs an interviewer-runner and scribe. Candidate will share screen for a short demo. Can someone pick up the runner role?

Elena: I can be scribe, happy to take notes and record the debrief doc.

Samir: I can do runner but juggling another meeting until 14:30 PT. If I take it I might need a 5min buffer to handover.

Jordan: @Samir thanks — would you be comfortable kicking off the call + inviting the hiring manager?

Samir: Yep, I can start the call and add the HM. Will also confirm screen-sharing permission with candidate.

Maya: Quick rubric Q — for system design demo, do we prioritize architecture tradeoffs over execution details? want to make scribe anchors explicit.

Priya: Good Q @Maya. Please weight: 60% design reasoning, 30% execution/clarity, 10% communication. Add a short note in the debrief doc if demo used prepared slides.

Ken: Can someone confirm where to drop the recording? We usually put it in the candidate folder in drive, under /hiring/interviews/YYYY-MM-DD/.

people-ops-bot: Reminder set — add recording link + debrief doc template to candidate folder after interview.

Aisha: I'll own the post-interview normalization step (timestamps + anonymized notes) if Elena is taking scribe.

Elena: Yep, scribe -> I'll paste the notes in the template and flag any rubric items I wasn't sure about.

Priya: Thanks all. Final checklist for runner (short):
```
- Start meeting 5 min early
- Admit candidate, confirm screen share works
- Add hiring manager + recorder to call
- Mute background participants, ask candidate to start demo
- After call, upload recording + link to debrief doc
```

Priya: @Samir if you can confirm by 14:45 PT I'll mark runner as assigned. Also ping if you need the HM's calendar link. :thumbsup:

Samir: Confirmed — I'll take runner and will ping if anything changes.

Priya: Awesome. Leaving the thread open for any rubric micro-adjusts. If anyone spots a conflict I'll reassign. :wave:
